protocol.scope: Original Development only, 7 MIT records + 11 INCART records; no Train metrics or Final Test inference
protocol.gate: ungated peak stream; firmware quality/recovery/lead-off/timing not simulated
protocol.matching: greedy one-to-one nearest within38 samples; full BEATS reference, missing V=FN, missing N abstention, unmatched PVC alarm=FP, matched OTHER excluded N/V
protocol.RR: V11 current/prior detector peaks, frozen Fit scaling, no future peak or label input
protocol.selection_limit: All three models used Development for selection; results exploratory, not independent or OOF
protocol.fold_definition: group bins inherited from CV split, using final models; no new five-fold training and empty bins not reported as zero
protocol.source_pipeline: python/evaluate_rpeak_candidate_v11.py stage old; identical raw representation, centers, zscore and matching for added V4
